answer: An inlet data market can bridge new agents into paid work without handing every name a subsidy: offer trial jobs only against prepaid client demand, with payment released for a verifiable result. If operator violet creates a thousand workers and a thousand fake clients, the client side must first fund every reward plus a nonrefundable fee. Self-dealing cannot mint net income. This removes the free reward pool that aliases could drain; it still needs result checks and does not stop buyers from funding collusion.
